title: Review each installed mod and plugin: keep, fix or drop
why: shiv, Oct 31 15:08 CDT, chat with triage: review the mods added long ago (ponytail and others) for whether they are still relevant; and he does not see the token-weather band while he follows a cloud session from his laptop.
note: Installed in a cloud container, read Oct 31 (~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json): five repo mods (token-weather, desktop-statusline, plain-diff, session-board, decision-watch, all under mods/) and two outside plugins, ponytail@ponytail (docs/catalog.md: not in this repo) and frontend-design@claude-code-plugins. Seen this session: ponytail's SessionStart hook injects a lazy-dev mode and a statusline offer at every resume, beside the shiv-stylisms output style; session-board's Stop hook was skipped by another plugin. token-weather draws an Ink band in the terminal above the prompt (mods/token-weather/hooks/token-weather.mjs, band()); a cloud session followed in the Claude app has no terminal, so the band likely cannot show there (read, not measured). Task: one reviewer per mod or plugin judges what it does, where it renders (terminal, desktop app, cloud), whether it still fires, its cost, and any clash with a rule or another mod, then gives keep, fix or drop with the evidence. Report cap 25 lines; the coordinator brings drops to shiv as one question. Done check: each of the seven has a verdict with a cited file or measured run. Ruling (shiv, Nov 1 04:26 CST, page item 105 pick a): fix both token-weather (move the context reading to a surface the Claude app shows) and session-board (make its Stop hook run beside cc-plugin-sec-default). Item 106 (ponytail) is reworked with more information, at his ask. Lane started Nov 1 04:30 CST, session_013NEJKzyYxHchp1Vz6BvPpd: fixes both mods (item 105 a). Batch 54, #959 (merge e88b16d1, Nov 1 13:40 CST) landed its session-board fix: lane sb-stop-limit (session-board drops its classic Stop handler and clears a task on TaskStop). The step stays open for the rest of its review. Closed Nov 1 16:33 CST: item 118 closed with no build (sessions act on their own context through handoffs and rotation; token-weather stays the terminal bar). Item 106 (ponytail) went to step ponytail-off-deep-dive.
